(after defeating the [[Dreadspawn Maw]]) | pic1 = [[File:Stygian Veil map.jpg|200px]] | pic1-text = Clean map. | pic2 = [[File:Stygian Veil map2.jpg|200px]] | pic2-text = Map showing quests paths. }} The [[Stygian Veil]] is a section of the [[Domain of Anguish]]. It is a land covered by strong malignant forces that turned it into one of many corrupted shards of existence and, in turn, a [[demon]]ic breeding ground within [[the Mists]]. It is also the strongest and most prolific such breeding grounds known to the [[Forgotten]]. It is lorded over by the [[Dreadspawn Maw]] which has seemingly become part of the land itself, and is guarded by the half-formed demons known as [[Stygian]]s. {{TOCright}} ==Bounty== *[[Whispers
